description: This PHP script manages test case execution assignment, including assigning, removing, and notifying testers via email within the TestLink open source test management system. It handles user input, interacts with database objects, and generates views for test case assignment.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for data structures and passing parameters.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters into an object for processing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure with test plan, project, and user info.

methods.name: send_mail_to_testers
methods.description: Composes and sends email notifications to testers about test case assignment changes.

methods.name: doRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all selected test case assignments and optionally notifies testers.

methods.name: doBulkUserRemove
methods.description: Removes multiple users from test case assignments in bulk, with optional email notifications.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for executing test case assignment actions.
